scores.label: Scoped WSG audit score
scores.formula: 100 * passed / (passed + failed + cantTell), grouped once per guideline

impactWeighted.status: Experimental project convention using WSG impact priority points; not a W3C site score

scores.interpretation: Passes satisfy only the declared scoped expectations; unknowns earn no points but are not defects. Compare only matching rubric, sample, and evidence profiles.

guidelines.title: Identify, assess, disclose, review, and mitigate sustainability impacts
guidelines.expectation: A retrieved public sustainability statement identifies the audited service and describes its impacts and mitigation. Judge disclosure only, not execution; an unresolved relationship is cantTell.

judgments.rationale: The path-scoped exporter homepage defines its library purpose but contains no sustainability impact/mitigation statement. Bounded origin discovery found no records and only two common origin-level disclosure routes, both 404. That does not prove a statement is absent elsewhere or across wagtail.github.io, and no service-linked statement can be judged from this packet.
judgments.nextEvidence: Provide a public statement explicitly relating to /draftjs_exporter/ and its web-service impact/mitigation boundary if such disclosure is intended.

guidelines.title: Understand user requirements or constraints
Integrate sustainability into every stage of the ideation process
Design efficient and streamlined user journeys
guidelines.expectation: Execute declared task actions and inspect completion evidence; an expected selector is one observable, not proof of user success or optimal journey length.

judgments.rationale: The timestamped setup observation records entering getting started in the documentation search, choosing the matching result, reaching /draftjs_exporter/getting-started/ and reading both the installation command and complete first-render example. The later automated journey failed during initial Page.goto with ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED and executed no actions; it supplies no contradictory task-state evidence and no measured journey result. This pass rests on the attributed contextual walkthrough only, not a claim of optimal length or universal completion.
judgments.nextEvidence: Repeat the route in a linked session if reproducible measured completion or timing is required; separate local transport errors from site behavior.

guidelines.title: Design to assist and not to distract
guidelines.expectation: Assess visible distractions against the declared visitor task; distinguish useful prompts from interruptions.

judgments.rationale: The rendered installation, content-state, API and migration reading states show no autoplay media or active animations. The small search dialog/prompt is part of documentation discovery, not an unrelated interruption. The contextual installation walkthrough completed without an account, payment or extra fields. This supports the observed reading/search states, not all future dialogs. However, this does not resolve the entire declared page sample: some normal JavaScript-enabled observations are missing or blocked, so quiet successful states cannot stand in for those unobserved states.
judgments.nextEvidence: Capture the missing normal documentation states, then review task interruptions and useful prompts across the declared sample.

guidelines.title: Avoid being manipulative or deceptive
guidelines.expectation: Inspect choice wording, defaults, prominence and the observed accept/reject paths for undue steering. DOM text alone does not establish visual parity.

judgments.rationale: The sample contains documentation navigation and search rather than consent, subscription, purchase or comparable accept/reject choices. The contextual route explicitly encountered no account/payment/personal-data fields. Engine recommendations are technical documentation; their tradeoffs are assessed under service-necessity rather than treating them as manipulative transaction controls.
judgments.nextEvidence: Review wording and visual accept/reject paths if consequential consent or payment choices enter scope.

guidelines.title: Make deliverables understandable and reusable
guidelines.expectation: Assess the sampled task's wording, headings and terminology for its stated audience; retain uncertainty about unrepresented users.

judgments.rationale: For Python developers, the home page states ContentState-to-HTML purpose and directs newcomers to Content state or Getting started. The installation article supplies pip install draftjs_exporter and a complete first render. Engine guidance explains dependencies, speed and sanitization/output differences; migration notes identify affected Python versions and concrete upgrade actions. This supports sampled developer wording, not comprehension for every audience. Clean configuration and API observations supply content-specific headings and terminology for the remaining reference tasks.
judgments.nextEvidence: Validate unfamiliar-user comprehension with research if broadening the target audience.

guidelines.title: Use a design system for interface consistency
guidelines.expectation: Compare repeated navigation and control names across sampled pages; consistent samples do not prove a documented design system.

judgments.rationale: Captured pages repeat the same Home, Getting started, Content state, Migration guide, Guides and Reference names with consistent Search and Clear controls. Configuration is also captured in a later clean state. The repeated task navigation supports sampled interface consistency; it does not establish an owned design system or every interactive state. Clean alternate homepage and engines states preserve the shared navigation names where initial probes failed.
judgments.nextEvidence: Compare any future custom controls against the existing shared navigation and names.

guidelines.title: Optimize media to reduce resource use
guidelines.expectation: The sampled task images preserve useful content and provide proportionate intrinsic dimensions and delivery choices for their rendered size and pixel density. A large image is an investigation candidate until legibility and task value are checked; absent srcset alone is not a failure.

judgments.rationale: The actual rendered reading pages use a shared 128-by-128 PNG logo at about 24 CSS pixels, around 3.1 kB transferred, with no heavy article images or video. This small reusable logo preserves branding at the observed sizes; absent srcset does not by itself establish a useful optimization. No speculative rendition or savings claim follows. Clean alternate states for home, configuration and engines, plus migration, show the same small logo rather than additional article media.
judgments.nextEvidence: Check any future content images at intended sizes and pixel densities; the present logo is not a priority optimization target.

guidelines.title: Ensure animation is proportionate and easy to control
guidelines.expectation: Assess observed animation purpose, playback controls and reduced-motion behavior. A quiet snapshot does not prove no motion occurs elsewhere.

judgments.rationale: No active animations or media playback appear in the clean desktop, narrow or reduced-motion observations. Thus no observed motion requires playback controls in these reading states. Quiet snapshots do not establish absence of transitions or motion after other actions. However, this does not resolve the entire declared page sample: some normal JavaScript-enabled observations are missing or blocked, so quiet successful states cannot stand in for those unobserved states.
judgments.nextEvidence: Capture the missing normal documentation states, then review any actual motion, its purpose and controls across the declared sample.

guidelines.title: Use optimized web typography
guidelines.expectation: Observed web fonts and variants serve the sampled content, with a declared fallback/loading strategy where needed. Do not fail a site merely for using a web font; recommend removal or subsetting only after language and readability requirements are established.

judgments.rationale: Observed FontFace lists are empty and body typography uses preinstalled system fonts with Helvetica/Arial/sans-serif fallbacks. No web-font responses are present in the successful homepage resource sample. This supports a font strategy without external font downloads for the sampled English reading content; no subsetting/removal recommendation is warranted.
judgments.nextEvidence: Reassess fallback coverage if supported languages or custom font requirements change.

guidelines.title: Avoid unwanted notifications
guidelines.expectation: Assess observed alerts and notification permission requests for user value and choice; absence is limited to observed states.

judgments.rationale: The observed pages record zero notification permission request calls and no unsolicited notification flow. Browser permission is denied, so the finding is limited to observed request behavior, not all possible browser/user states. However, this does not resolve the entire declared page sample: some normal JavaScript-enabled observations are missing or blocked, so quiet successful states cannot stand in for those unobserved states.
judgments.nextEvidence: Capture the missing normal documentation states, then review alerts and permission requests across the declared sample.

guidelines.title: Reduce the impact of downloadable and physical documents
guidelines.expectation: Review print layout visibility and download labels for the declared task. Fetch and inspect document content before asserting optimization or equivalence.

judgments.rationale: No downloadable document links were recorded on the observed pages. Print emulation keeps installation text and removes navigation in that page, while API and migration print states still report many navigation regions, potentially including technical subsection links. No paginated preview establishes actual page count, duplication or clipping, so these counts cannot prove inefficient paper use.
judgments.nextEvidence: Check an API/migration print preview with real content before changing print styles; preserve code and upgrade steps.

guidelines.title: Involve users early in the project
Audit and test for bugs or issues requiring resolution
Validate usability through testing and real-world usage
Provide cross-platform compatibility support
guidelines.expectation: The sampled core reading content and navigation remain available without JavaScript, or an explicit alternative supports the task. This bounded check does not establish no-JavaScript search, every interaction, or all browser compatibility.

judgments.rationale: Fresh no-JavaScript home, installation, content-state, engines and migration states retain their reading text/headings/navigation. No-JavaScript configuration and API navigations fail with ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED, so their core reading availability is unresolved. Failed navigation is not proof those static articles require JavaScript, and enhanced search/copy interactions are outside this bounded reading check.
judgments.nextEvidence: Capture clean no-JavaScript API/configuration pages and compare their complete reading text/navigation with matching normal states.

guidelines.title: Set goals based on performance and energy impact
Minify and remove unused code
guidelines.expectation: Use initial JS/CSS execution observations to nominate investigation targets; require representative journeys or source corroboration before recommending removal.

judgments.rationale: The initial main-target coverage includes unexecuted ranges in the roughly 35 kB compressed documentation bundle and unused CSS rules. Those source-position ranges are not removable transfer bytes. The sample has interactive search, navigation and copy-code needs, but no representative complete coverage of those interactions and no source corroboration.
judgments.nextEvidence: Cover search, navigation and copy-code actions before removing bundle or CSS content; retain code needed after initial reading.

guidelines.title: Modularize bandwidth-heavy components
guidelines.expectation: Relate initial script resources to visible components and later task needs; recommend splitting only when a component's deferred use and usable activation are corroborated.

judgments.rationale: Initial loading includes a roughly 35 kB compressed bundle and a roughly 64 kB compressed search index. Search is a real and successfully used task in the contextual route, so treating the index as unused would be unjustified. A search worker is not fully accounted for in staged collection. Evidence does not demonstrate a safe on-demand activation path or quantify any deferral savings.
judgments.nextEvidence: If initial-load optimization is needed, prototype index loading on search activation, then verify immediate typing, result readiness and complete worker accounting before adopting it.

guidelines.title: Avoid redundancy and duplication in code
Treat third parties the same as first parties
Ensure code follows good semantic practices
guidelines.expectation: The sampled document has a meaningful language, primary heading and main region, and task controls have visible labels or an explicit naming relationship. Count/attribute presence alone does not establish semantic correctness or WCAG compliance. The sampled initial keyboard path reaches visible task navigation/controls in a meaningful order with a discernible focus indicator. A bounded Tab trace cannot establish complete keyboard support, reverse navigation, traps or screen-reader accessibility.

judgments.rationale: Every sampled page has at least one clean captured state with lang=en, one main and a descriptive primary heading matching its content. Search and Clear carry explicit aria-labels; navigation labels identify drawer sections. Icon-only copy buttons have the title Copy to clipboard, supplying an HTML naming fallback rather than evidence of an unnamed control. This is the bounded document/naming expectation, not a WCAG or full heading-structure verdict.
judgments.nextEvidence: If extending the review, verify copy-button names/tooltips in an accessibility tree and assess the API heading hierarchy beyond this bounded check.

judgments.rationale: The bounded Tab traces reach skip/home links, named Search where initialized, repository link and task navigation in a meaningful sequence. Most links have focus-visible and auto outlines. Search records outline-style none, and one intermediate search dialog node is marked not visible; borders/shadows or active dialog behavior were not captured enough to verify their actual focus indicators. This is insufficient to fail keyboard support or claim a trap, but prevents a complete discernible-focus pass.
judgments.nextEvidence: Visually verify focus on the Search input and dialog controls, and capture the skip link and subsequent path; include reverse traversal if broadening keyboard coverage.

guidelines.title: Defer the loading of non-critical resources
Structure metadata for machine readability
guidelines.expectation: The sampled content has a descriptive title and usable canonical metadata when applicable; declared structured-data blocks parse as JSON. Judge description and other optional metadata according to page purpose, not a mandatory-field checklist.

judgments.rationale: Clean states provide descriptive content-specific titles, absolute self-canonical URLs under /draftjs_exporter/ and purpose-specific descriptions. No structured-data blocks are declared, so no JSON parse failure is present. Alternate clean states are used where the first navigation failed; no canonical claim is made for the rest of wagtail.github.io.
judgments.nextEvidence: Keep canonical URLs aligned with published paths; validate structured data if introduced.

guidelines.title: Use media queries that support sustainability goals
guidelines.expectation: The sampled page respects applicable dark/reduced-motion preferences both before navigation and when they change in-page, without losing task content. Distinguish intentional design choices and absence of applicable motion from unsupported behavior.

judgments.rationale: The clean pages remain light in desktop, live-dark and cold-dark states while preserving reading content. No actual motion is observed to suppress. Unlike an implemented theme that works only on initial load, these observations do not establish that this service offers a dark theme or its intended preference policy. A fixed light design alone is insufficient to declare a failure under the scoped instruction to consider intentional choices.
judgments.nextEvidence: Establish the theme configuration/design intent and any user controls; if system-theme following is intended, verify both initial and live changes against that requirement.

guidelines.title: Ensure layouts work for different devices and requirements
guidelines.expectation: Compare narrow and desktop task content and overflow, then exercise affected controls; width emulation alone is not real-device compatibility.

judgments.rationale: Captured installation, content-state, API and migration pages retain headings/content and report no document overflow at 360 and 1280 CSS pixels. The responsive menu/search controls were not exercised at the narrow width, and desktop/narrow comparisons are missing for some pages after transport errors. These limits prevent a full scoped functional layout judgment.
judgments.nextEvidence: Exercise narrow navigation/search and long API/code content on clean pages, with a real mobile task if claiming device compatibility.

guidelines.title: Use sustainable JavaScript and APIs
guidelines.expectation: Repeated observed API requests are justified by the sampled task and its update needs. Identify redundant-looking requests for investigation without inferring backend cost or safe removal from URL repetition alone.

judgments.rationale: The homepage loads /draftjs_exporter/sitemap.xml successfully as XML (200, 788 bytes), whereas content-state, configuration, API and engine pages each request a page-relative sitemap.xml and receive 404 HTML, roughly 3.9 kB each. These completed error requests do not provide the sitemap data requested by the reading/navigation enhancement and establish an avoidable failed-request pattern across the sample. Distinct search-index/repository/release requests are not called duplicates; no polling, backend cost or whole-journey savings is inferred.
judgments.nextEvidence: Resolve sitemap fetching against the documentation root and verify root/nested page navigation succeeds with the intended XML; retain useful search/release requests.

guidelines.title: Use dependencies sparingly and maintain them
Include expected and beneficial files
guidelines.expectation: The sampled service exposes a discoverable, parseable carbon.txt with usable declared relationships. Missing carbon.txt is a scoped absence, not proof of high emissions or failure of the entire guideline. Judge redirects, delegation, supported versions and schema findings explicitly.

judgments.rationale: The origin root and well-known carbon.txt routes return 404, with no Carbon-Location, redirect or DNS discovery relationship available. A parseable file and its declared schema/version/delegation therefore cannot be established for this service through the sampled standard discovery routes. This scoped absence neither establishes high emissions nor authorizes claims about every project hosted on wagtail.github.io.
judgments.nextEvidence: If useful, coordinate origin-level carbon.txt/delegation with the host owner, naming the exporter relationship accurately; validate the retrieved version/schema and substantiation.

guidelines.title: Use the most efficient solution for your service
Use the latest stable language version
Reduce the number and complexity of database queries
Use sustainable hosting
guidelines.expectation: Hosting claims identify provider, service and supporting evidence with a relationship to this origin. Self-declaration without independently corroborated operational scope remains cantTell for sustainable hosting; do not set SWDM green-hosting flags from this check.

judgments.rationale: The github.io origin and GitHub response/resource routes identify delivery context, but no service-specific provider sustainability statement or independent operational evidence is retrieved. Provider identity alone cannot establish renewable-energy, hardware or emissions performance for this documentation path. No green-hosting model flag follows.
judgments.nextEvidence: Supply a dated operational hosting record with a defensible relationship to this origin/path and independently corroborated scope if making a sustainable-hosting claim.

guidelines.title: Optimize caching and support offline access
guidelines.expectation: Reusable public scripts/styles/media expose an appropriate caching or validation policy in the sample. Distinguish dynamic/private responses and note that headers alone do not prove cache reuse or offline support.

judgments.rationale: Successful reusable first-party CSS, JavaScript, image and search-index responses expose max-age=600 plus ETags. Public GitHub API responses expose public max-age=60/s-maxage=60 plus ETags. These support bounded reuse or validation policies; missing headers on failed sitemap responses and incomplete worker accounting do not establish a general caching failure. Warm reuse and offline access were not measured.
judgments.nextEvidence: Use warm-load observations before claiming saved bytes; review longer caching only where versioned assets and platform controls make it appropriate.

guidelines.title: Reduce data transfer with compression
guidelines.expectation: Material sampled text assets are delivered with compression where beneficial. Do not demand compression for already-compressed images, tiny bodies or error responses without context.

judgments.rationale: Successful material HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JSON search-index and GitHub API responses use gzip. Compressed delivery is directly supported for these observed text assets. Worker response accounting is incomplete and two staged pages failed navigation; neither their missing bytes nor already-compressed image data is treated as an efficiency success or compression defect.
judgments.nextEvidence: Recheck unobserved responses in a linked complete collection if expanding the transfer claim; no specific compression repair is established.

guidelines.title: Setup necessary error pages and redirection links
Avoid maintaining unnecessary virtualized environments or containers
Use automation wisely
Define the frequency of data refreshes
Back up critical data at routine intervals
Assess the impact and requirements of data processing
Use Content Delivery Networks (CDNs) when beneficial
Ensure infrastructure fits project requirements
Store data according to the needs of your users
Have an ethical and sustainable product strategy
Assign a sustainability advocate
Inform, raise awareness, and train for sustainability
Communicate the environmental impact of user choices
guidelines.expectation: Identify consequential user choices in the sample and assess whether contextual impact information is useful and supported. Do not prescribe carbon labels on every control.

judgments.rationale: The scoped visitor reads installation/usage guidance. There is no established high-transfer media-quality, bulk-export or similar consequential web-service choice. Engine advice describes software speed/dependency/sanitization tradeoffs, without measured environmental comparisons; the reading site does not need carbon labels on ordinary navigation or every engine name.
judgments.nextEvidence: Reassess if measured operational-impact choices are added; any future environmental comparison needs a comparable workload and boundary.

guidelines.title: Calculate the environmental impact
Define clear organizational sustainability goals and metrics
Validate web sustainability efforts through external verification
Support mandatory disclosures and reporting
Create one or more impact business models
Follow a product management and maintenance strategy
Implement continuous improvement procedures
Document updates and evolutions
Evaluate if a digital product or service is necessary
guidelines.expectation: A selected product, service or substantial feature decision evaluates user desirability, technical feasibility and ongoing viability against credible alternatives, including reuse or no new feature where relevant. A marketing claim of demand or absence of a public decision record alone cannot determine necessity. For the declared visitor task and represented access constraints, inspect material accessibility, technical, geographic or fairness barriers and verify the sampled route or alternative supports task completion while preserving necessary security and safety. Do not demand removal of justified authentication or infer all-user accessibility from one successful route.

judgments.assessmentScope: The documented creation/continuation rationale for the Python Draft.js ContentState-to-HTML exporter capability, limited to the current homepage purpose statement and published alternative-engine tradeoffs. Assess whether these public records establish desirability, feasibility, viability and alternatives; do not infer unpublished business decisions or a site-wide necessity judgment.
judgments.rationale: The homepage explains a concrete need for ContentState-to-HTML conversion in Python/Wagtail/Django and ongoing Wagtail contributor maintenance. Engine guidance documents dependency, speed, sanitization and output-stability tradeoffs, supporting partial technical feasibility and alternatives. It does not document a creation/continuation evaluation of desirability and ongoing viability against credible capability-level alternatives or reuse. Public purpose/maintenance claims alone do not complete that decision assessment.
judgments.nextEvidence: Provide one bounded public creation/continuation decision explaining user demand, viable maintenance/resources and considered alternatives or reuse, and why the chosen exporter capability remains appropriate.

judgments.assessmentScope: Anonymous English-reading desktop Chromium visitor, 1280 × 800 CSS pixels, using keyboard text entry and pointer selection: search from the documentation homepage for getting started, reach the installation command and complete first-render example without account creation, payment or submission. Keyboard-only traversal, assistive technologies, other countries and representative-user testing are outside this task scope.
judgments.rationale: Within the exact anonymous English desktop pointer/text-entry scope, the timestamped walkthrough follows documentation search to Getting started and captures the installation command plus complete render example without account, payment, personal-data fields or external navigation. Later automation failed before reaching the homepage with ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED and performed no task actions, so it does not demonstrate a contrary visitor barrier. This pass is limited to the attributed single environment and task, excluding keyboard-only and representative-user claims.
judgments.nextEvidence: Repeat with represented users or other constraints only if extending the declared scope; obtain a clean linked run for measured journey reliability.

guidelines.title: Provide a supplier standards of practice document
Share economic benefits
Share decision-making power with affected parties
Use Diversity, Equity, Justice, Inclusion (DEJI) practices
Promote responsible data practices
guidelines.expectation: For a declared content collection, evidence identifies a review/expiry schedule and demonstrates an applied archive, update or deletion decision, with a lightweight discoverable historical version where users still need it. A date label, old article or policy alone cannot establish an effective lifecycle or justify deletion.

judgments.assessmentScope: Public Draft.js exporter documentation under /draftjs_exporter/ as captured for this audit: assess the documented update/review lifecycle and applied compatibility guidance in the current migration guide, including retained upgrade instructions for earlier releases. Date labels alone do not establish a review schedule; repository maintenance and unpublished processes are outside scope.
judgments.rationale: The migration guide retains discoverable version-specific upgrade instructions from v0.8 through v7, records concrete changed behavior and compatible releases for obsolete Python versions, and supplies current compatibility guidance. This is useful applied maintenance evidence. The date labels and release-organized sections do not establish an explicit review/expiry schedule, ownership or a documented review decision, so the whole lifecycle expectation remains unresolved. Historical migration content has continuing user value and should not be deleted merely for age.
judgments.nextEvidence: Publish or supply a release-linked documentation review schedule and one applied review/update record, retaining old upgrade paths while clearly distinguishing historical instructions from current configuration.

guidelines.title: Establish responsible practices around AI and emerging or disruptive technologies
Adopt responsible financial practices
Adopt organizational philanthropy practices
Plan for a digital product or service's care and end-of-life
Repair, reuse, refurbish, recycle or reduce e-waste
Define performance, environmental, and human budgets
Use and contribute to open source
Create a business continuity and disaster recovery plan
